metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.1 · 2015 · Inside Out
metas.description: After young Riley is uprooted from her Midwest life and moved to San Francisco, her emotions, Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust, and Sadness, conflict on how best to navigate a new city, house, and school.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Inside Out 2
metas.description: A sequel that features Riley entering puberty and experiencing brand new, more complex emotions as a result. As Riley tries to adapt to her teenage years, her old emotions try to adapt to the possibility of being replaced.
